scope: Original analysis evidence records; component experiments are not full benchmark reproductions

records.depth_scope: One v1 workspace task, its environment and task-level execution/assessment flow
records.finding: Normal-task utility and attacker-goal success have separate semantics. Security booleans also have no-attack and error-branch defaults, so they cannot all be read as observed malicious actions.
records.limitations: No attack or tool execution. v1 task semantics not assumed for later task versions.

records.depth_scope: Four complete actual metadata rows and previously traced evaluation code; no media inspection
records.finding: Four related question rows have separate question/options columns and differing level labels; group-level and question-level classification use different units.
records.limitations: No video downloaded or watched. No model evaluation. Task text and answers not republished.

records.depth_scope: Isolated source-function experiment on synthetic all-failing ten-sample inputs; overall benchmark depth remains D1
records.finding: Auxiliary caller evaluates k beyond available samples without the main path's n>=k guard, producing misleading ones on the synthetic invalid-domain inputs.
records.limitations: Not a model result, not the guarded main evaluator, not evidence that published scores use invalid inputs.

records.finding: Updated deployment signals have distinct event units and missingness rules; current production method explicitly treats orchestrator-only K=1, unlike pairwise preference ratings.
records.limitations: No production implementation, assignment logs or user-trace audit; exact classifier and weighting parameters unavailable.

records.depth_scope: Overall D1 because real game frame/full metadata missing; detailed harness/scorer source trace is included
records.finding: The inspected official harness renders integer-grid text rather than image inputs. State retention, action budgets and operation mode are separate comparison conditions.
records.limitations: No API key, online scorecard, game download or game execution; server scorer not audited.

records.depth_scope: Isolated arithmetic class and run-list property, synthetic inputs only
records.finding: Squared efficiency, level weighting and completion cap are reproduced. The local multi-run property chooses maximum score, not mean.
records.limitations: No valid game trajectory claimed for guard fixtures; local multi-run property not generalized to competition server.

records.depth_scope: Real fixed task fixture and recommended Inspect generation/scoring path
records.finding: Problem 77 combines numerical targets and scientific trajectory checks across dependent generated functions. Recommended and deprecated paths differ in bookkeeping and caches.
records.limitations: HDF5 targets not fetched, live HF revision unpinned, no candidate/model execution.

records.depth_scope: Original evaluator class on synthetic metadata and cached pass labels, subprocess trapped
records.finding: Provided-context steps skipped from execution remain in total_steps, so all tested steps passing can still yield problem_correct=0 in the pinned branch.
records.limitations: Synthetic step counts not claimed to match real tasks; no inference about published-score impact or prevalence.
